hazards.message:
All 46 units are silent from 11537.0 s to 11643.5 s (106 s) while position is tracked. If the electrophysiology was not recording then, pass spike_window=(start, stop) so that time is excluded from occupancy.
1658106/1659773 spike_times (100%) across all neurons fell outside the position time window [0, 19964.3]; spike_times.min()=1.25952 spike_times.max()=1.99642e+07. The spike times span 1.99642e+07 and reach 1.99642e+07, about 1000 times the 19964.3 s of times: if spike_times are in milliseconds, divide them by 1000. Check that spike_times and times share units (both seconds). Dropped spikes do not contribute. Set warn_on_drop=False to suppress this warning.
